headline: Meta Opens Its React Design System
lede: Astryx brings 150-plus accessible React components, themes, dark mode, and templates into an adaptable StyleX foundation. Its typed, composable parts let teams move quickly without surrendering control of their CSS or brand language.

headline: An LLM Maps the Daily Market
lede: This stock-analysis platform pulls together prices, fundamentals, news, sentiment, and technical signals across Asian and Western markets. Dashboards, scheduled reports, backtesting, and agent chat turn a sprawling data stack into a repeatable research flow.

headline: Google Teaches Coding Agents the Modern Web
lede: Modern Web Guidance gives coding agents compact, searchable instruction on HTML, CSS, JavaScript, accessibility, performance, and browser APIs. Its workflows also identify legacy patterns and steer implementations toward native platform capabilities.

headline: Improve Turns Repository Audits Into Plans
lede: Improve does not change the code; it maps the terrain first. Parallel agents inspect security, testing, performance, dependencies, and product direction, then assemble evidence-backed plans with boundaries, stop conditions, and verification gates.

headline: Agent Skills Gives Coding a Production Process
lede: Agent Skills lays out a practical route from specification to shipment through structured commands for planning, implementation, testing, review, and release. Its checkpoints and anti-rationalization rules make autonomous work more procedural—and easier to inspect.

headline: A Rust CLI Gives Agents a Browser
lede: Agent-browser turns websites into compact accessibility trees that agents can inspect and operate from the shell. Persistent sessions, downloads, screenshots, authentication, and debugging make the rugged command line a credible interface for real browser work.

headline: Sure Rebuilds Personal Finance for Its Users
lede: Sure carries forward the abandoned Maybe Finance codebase as a self-hostable platform for budgets, investments, and wealth management. Docker deployment, multiple clients, and an AGPL foundation keep household financial data closer to home.

headline: Home Assistant Connects to the Assistant Layer
lede: HA-MCP links Home Assistant with Claude, ChatGPT, and other MCP clients for conversational control of devices, automations, and configuration. Its in-process integration, secure endpoints, authentication options, and deployment paths are designed for dependable operation across installations.

headline: Codex Security Hunts and Repairs Vulnerabilities
lede: Codex Security scans repositories and diffs, investigates suspected flaws, and can propose and verify repairs instead of stopping at an alert. CLI, SDK, GitHub Actions, SARIF, and issue-tracker integrations carry the findings into an existing security process.

headline: Java’s Algorithm Library Keeps Fundamentals Runnable
lede: TheAlgorithms/Java gathers readable implementations of sorting, graphs, searching, mathematics, strings, and cryptography in one open reference. Its emphasis is study rather than maximal optimization, giving learners and interview candidates code they can run, compare, and extend.
